reading.title: Move with Me
reading.purpose: Hear a rhyme and move your body to the words.
paras:
Stretch up tall, reach for the sky.
Wiggle your fingers and wave goodbye.

Crawl like a baby across the floor.
Climb up the steps, then climb some more.

Jump, jump, jump, one, two, three!
Now sit down quiet and breathe with me.

choices: push off the ground into the air.
qs.why: A baby crawls across the floor on hands and knees.

qs.q: What do we wiggle in the rhyme?
qs.why: The rhyme says to wiggle your fingers.

qs.q: What do we do three times?
qs.why: The rhyme says jump, jump, jump, one, two, three.

reading.retellFrame: In the rhyme, we stretch and ___.
